changes.after: House-passed HCS1 would require qualifying data-center electric service contracts, tariffs, at least $75,000 initial application fees and studies, and dedicated resources for projected peak loads over 25 MW for municipal utilities and over 250 MW for regulated retail suppliers. Sections 1 and 3 exempt TVA distributors, DOE-site data centers and preexisting electric-service contracts. Sections 2 and 4 provide water, sewage and gas cost protections with an expressly stated DOE-site exception; do not extend the electric-contract or TVA exceptions uniformly to those sections. Proposed substitute text, not enacted requirements.
